items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's statements about Mark Niel's habits and relationship to Ivie Anderson, without providing any personal anecdote or direct interaction with Niel himself.

ctx.x: Oh, don't believe that. He used to put it right in his pocket here and he used to have two or three $100 bills in there all the time.
That's when Mark Niel used to tell him ...
Oh, just like Freddie Guy, all the time, Freddie had at last a one hundred dollar bill in his pocket all the time.
